Needs changes before merge.

The four corner tests in motion and the Face tests in the app pass. The tests also cover undo, redo, the MCP edit and the air entry. I checked each line of the five new CL files. Each file has the expected entry, row order, feed depth and retract. All five files are in **Goldens moved**.

### Local results

Trial merge with upstream main at `d80dc6944f912171a06029f635e0450c505d44a9`.

- Quick gate: 927 of 929 steps passed. Two steps failed. No step stalled. The CL, post, motion, app and UI build checks passed.
- Face tests: 13 motion tests and 9 app tests passed. The app test for the turned boundary and the UI test for the Geometry tab also passed.
- Catalog tests: 43 passed and 4 were ignored in `example_catalog`. One test passed in each of `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work`.
- Golden suites: `golden_cl` passed 34 tests. `solid_law_goldens` passed 7. `golden_undercut` passed 4. `conformance` passed 7.
- The UI library suite passed 1,651 tests and failed 7. Bare upstream main failed the same seven tests. The headless host has no usable GPU adapter. These seven failures do not block the PR.

  ```text
  Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
  egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter
  ```

- The CADMPEG suite passed 12 tests and failed one in the quick gate. The same command passed all 13 tests on bare main and on the trial merge when run again.

  ```text
  cadmpeg did not finish `--version` within 3s and was stopped; nothing was imported
  ```
- Clippy passed for `camcraft-motion`, `camcraft-app` and `camcraft-ui` with `--all-targets -- -D warnings`.
- The release light gate passed all six steps. The steps cover motion library tests, three adaptive suites and the app pocket pass-start suite.

### Extra suites run

The quick gate ran these suites by name for the changed golden directories and the toolpath change. Each suite listed here passed.

- `camcraft-app` passed. `agie_native`, `altmill_machines`, `carried_engine_agreement`, `conformance`, `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `face_start_exit`, `g_edm_post`, `golden_cl`, `grblhal_post`, `lathe_post_inch`, `mcp_multiaxis_deburr_post`, `microarc_test_part`, `plasma_post`, `plasma_post_refusals`, `post_cycle_feed_spindle`, `program_comments`, `program_units`, `sinker_burn`, `sodick_wire_dielectric`, `sodick_wire_passes`, `sodick_wire_post`, `solid_law_goldens`, `stock_engine_agreement`, `tinyg_post`, `tormach_end_units`, `tormach_fourth_axis`, `tormach_machines`, `tormach_post`, `wire_4axis`, `wire_burnout`, `wire_dxf_selection`, `wire_iso_decimal`, `wire_post`, `wire_tabs`, `wire_taper`, `wire_taper_angle`.
- `camcraft-cl` passed. `headless_bin`.
- `camcraft-motion` passed. `face_start_exit`, `golden_undercut`.
- `camcraft-post` passed. `arc_planes`, `bore_cycle`, `cycle_hop`, `doosan_dnm_post`, `explain_remaining`, `explain_tormach`, `fanuc_post`, `fine_bore_cycle`, `grbl_dialect`, `heidenhain_block_form`, `heidenhain_cycles`, `inverted_post`, `inverted_probe`, `lib`, `post_engine`, `probe_dialects`, `probe_guard`, `probe_report`, `probe_rotated_wcs`, `probe_tormach`, `ream_cycle`, `ream_lathe`, `recorded_streams`, `script_agie_native`, `script_carvera`, `script_doosan_dnm`, `script_fanuc`, `script_fanuc_lathe`, `script_g_edm`, `script_grbl`, `script_grblhal`, `script_haas`, `script_heidenhain`, `script_heidenhain_klartext`, `script_linuxcnc`, `script_mach3`, `script_mach4`, `script_mazak`, `script_richauto`, `script_sinker_iso`, `script_sinker_side`, `script_sinumerik`, `script_sinumerik_810m`, `script_sodick_wire`, `script_tinyg`, `script_tormach`, `script_tormach_lathe`, `script_tormach_plasma`, `script_waterjet_iso`, `script_wire_iso`, `vertical_arc_entry`, `wcs_flip`, `wcs_flip_dialects`, `work_offset_index`.

### Safety checks

I ran two mutations in a separate source copy. The original and restored motion suites each passed all 13 tests.

- Removed the exit refusal. `an_exit_the_row_count_cannot_reach_is_refused_by_name` failed because the planner accepted an exit it could not reach.
- Used the former arc sense. `blended_turns_stay_outside_the_footprint_from_every_corner` failed because a descending reversal turned toward the footprint.

### Changes required before merge

1. `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:542` — Transform both Face picks into the same frame as the face region. For a work offset with Z rotation, `wcs_yaw::enter` rotates the geometry. Its `rotate_params` leaves the Face picks in model coordinates. In a local test with a 90-degree work offset, the model pick `(29, 19)` selected the low-X corner. The entry was approximately `(-25, 25)` mm. Add a test that checks the picked corner and exit under a rotated work offset.
2. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/face.rs:265` — Check the picked entry and exit after row clipping. The planner accepts the exit from the uncut row count. A local test removed the last of six rows with a keep-out. The function accepted a low-X exit and ended the cut at `(23, 5)` mm on high X. A keep-out can also remove the picked first row. Keep the protected area clear and give a diagnostic that names the blocked pick. Add a test with a keep-out that removes a terminal row.
3. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_page.rs:32` — Add before and after screenshots of the Face Geometry tab to the PR body. Link the images from the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch.
4. `crates/app/tests/cadmpeg_import.rs:221` — The quick gate failed the CADMPEG timeout test, and bare main passed the same test. The standalone trial merge retry also passed. The original red step remains open under the review rule. Supply a clean quick-gate result for this step.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the four findings of the review on `1c8359580`. The new head is `e07a88d0958b0b4f321be22d210df249c30283a4`. The PR is a draft.

1. **Face picks under a rotated work offset** (`generate.rs:542`). `wcs_yaw::rotate_params` now carries each start and exit pick into the generator frame with the geometry. The rule reads `OpParams::path_picks_mut`, so it holds for each kind that stores picks, not for Face only.
   - Pin: `a_rotated_work_offset_reads_the_picks_in_the_setup_frame` in `crates/app/tests/face_start_exit.rs`. The work offset turns 90 degrees about (5, 7). The model pick (29, 19) enters at (25, 25), beside the picked corner. The exit pick is read in the same frame, and an exit on the other side is refused by name.
   - Mutation: without the rotation the test is red. With it the test is green.
2. **Picks after row clipping** (`face.rs:265`). The planner now judges the picks again on the rows that each level cuts (`face_raster::Raster::held`). The check reads the final row pieces, so it covers the keep-out and the holes law. A taken first row refuses the start pick. A taken last row refuses the exit pick. The text names the blocked pick, and the refusal marks it. The protected area stays clear.
   - Pin: `a_keep_out_that_takes_a_terminal_row_refuses_the_blocked_pick_by_name` in `crates/motion/tests/face_start_exit.rs`. It uses your case (the last of six rows removed), the first row removed, an exit pick alone, no pick, and a keep-out on a middle row.
   - Mutation: without the check the test is red (the path is cut). With it the test is green.
3. **Screenshots.** The PR body has the before and after images of the Face Geometry tab. They are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `d0088946d`, folder `pr-3997/`. No image is in the PR branch.
4. **Quick gate, CADMPEG step.** `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` on `e07a88d09`: `wall 71.3 min, 928 step(s), 0 failed, 0 stalled`. `app suites: cadmpeg_import` is `ok in 5s`.

Other results on `e07a88d09`:

- Clippy for `camcraft-motion`, `camcraft-app` and `camcraft-ui` with `--all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Four targeted heavy steps (`motion heavy: face_holes`, `top_z_stock_over`, `arc_turn_kinds`, `app heavy: example_catalog`): 4 steps, 0 failed.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps, 0 failed.
- No recorded program changed in this round.

**One item needs a decision: the merge with main.** `upstream/main` moved to `baad348f1` (PR #3978, Slot) while the gates ran. This head now conflicts with it. I did not push a merge.

- `pick_kinds.rs` and `start_exit_shared.rs` have text conflicts where each side added lines. The resolution keeps the two additions.
- `wcs_yaw.rs`, `rotate_params`: git merges it without a conflict, but the two sides changed the same logic. Main rotates the Slot picks in the `OpParams::Slot` arm. This PR rotates the picks of each kind after the `match`. The merged function rotates the Slot picks two times.
- I recommend one rule: keep the loop after the `match`, and remove the pick loop from the Slot arm. Tell me if you want that, or the opposite (a Face arm and no general rule).

Please review the new head again.

Needs changes before merge. The four earlier findings are fixed. The PR conflicts with `upstream/main` `baad348f1`. A clean merge also gives a wrong Slot path, so the refresh must change one hunk by hand.

This is a re-review of head `e07a88d09`. It is a safety-tier review: the change moves the Face toolpath and its posted G-code.

### Earlier findings (review on `1c8359580`)

1. **Face picks under a rotated work offset** (`generate.rs:542`): fixed. `wcs_yaw::rotate_params` now turns each start and exit pick into the generator frame. `a_rotated_work_offset_reads_the_picks_in_the_setup_frame` passes. With the rotation removed, the test fails (my mutation A, below).
2. **Picks judged after row clipping** (`face.rs:265`): fixed. `face_raster::Raster::held` reads the cut row pieces at each level. `a_keep_out_that_takes_a_terminal_row_refuses_the_blocked_pick_by_name` passes. With the call removed, the test fails (my mutation B, below).
3. **Screenshots of the Face Geometry tab**: fixed. The body links three images on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `d0088946d`, folder `pr-3997/`. The three files are there. No image is in the PR branch.
4. **Red CADMPEG step in the quick gate**: fixed. The author's quick gate on `e07a88d09` shows `928 step(s), 0 failed, 0 stalled`, with `app suites: cadmpeg_import` `ok in 5s`.

### Results (local, on the PR head)

The PR does not merge with `upstream/main` `baad348f1`. There are text conflicts in `crates/app/src/operation/pick_kinds.rs` and `crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared.rs`. Thus I built and tested the PR head `e07a88d09` without a merge.

- `camcraft-motion --test face_start_exit`: 14 passed.
- `camcraft-app`:
  - `face_start_exit`: 10 passed.
  - `start_exit_shared`: 4 passed.
  - `contour_start_point`: 10 passed.
  - `example_catalog`: 43 passed, 4 ignored.
  - `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
  - `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
  - `golden_cl`: 34 passed.
  - `solid_law_goldens`: 7 passed.
- `camcraft-ui --lib start_exit` (run from `crates/ui`): 16 passed. This includes `the_face_geometry_tab_states_and_clears_its_start_and_exit` and `kinds_without_a_picked_start_say_so_by_name`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Heavy lanes: I did not run them. The author's targeted heavy run on `e07a88d09` is green (`face_holes`, `top_z_stock_over`, `arc_turn_kinds`, `app heavy: example_catalog`: 4 steps, 0 failed). By AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review", a heavy lane is not a condition for this `P2` PR.

### Extra suites run

- Golden directories: the diff adds five CL files in `crates/motion/tests/golden/` and `crates/app/tests/golden/`. I ran `golden_cl`, `solid_law_goldens`, the three `example_catalog*` suites and the two `face_start_exit` suites. All passed.
- Importers: the diff does not touch import code. No kernel suite is necessary.

### Goldens

The round 1 commit changes no recorded program (`git diff --stat 1c8359580 e07a88d09 -- "*.cl" "*.nc" examples/catalog` is empty). Against `upstream/main`, only the five new CL files differ. The body lists all five under "Goldens moved". The earlier review checked each line of these five files.

### Mutations (separate runs, code restored after each)

- A: remove the pick rotation at the end of `wcs_yaw::rotate_params`. Result: red, `a_rotated_work_offset_reads_the_picks_in_the_setup_frame` (`face_start_exit.rs:71`).
- B: remove `raster.held(&lv.pieces, z)?` in `face_picked`. Result: red, `a_keep_out_that_takes_a_terminal_row_refuses_the_blocked_pick_by_name` (`face_start_exit.rs:288`).

The restored head passed all the suites above.

### Requested before merge

1. **NEW blocker: the merge with `upstream/main` turns the Slot picks two times** (`crates/app/src/operation/wcs_yaw.rs`, `rotate_params`). Main (#3978) turns the Slot picks in the `OpParams::Slot` arm. The fix commit of this PR turns the picks of each kind after the `match`. Git merges this function with no conflict. I made the trial merge and read the result: the merged function contains the two loops. On a Slot under a Z-rotated work offset, each pick then turns two times, and the planner reads the wrong end. The earlier review could not see this: main got #3978, and this PR got the general rule, after that review.
   - Fix: in the refresh, keep the one rule after the `match`. Remove the pick loop from the `OpParams::Slot` arm. This is the author's recommendation in the "Merge with main" section of the body. I agree with it.
   - Pin: run the Slot yaw tests of #3978 and `a_rotated_work_offset_reads_the_picks_in_the_setup_frame` on the merged tree.
   - In `pick_kinds.rs` and `start_exit_shared.rs`, keep the two additions (Face `Raster` and Slot `Ends`). Name the three kinds in the panic text of the capability test.
2. **Pin the Contour change of the general rule** (`wcs_yaw.rs:373`). Before this PR, a Contour start or exit pick did not turn into the generator frame. The motion planner reads it there (`contour_start.rs:74`, `contour_start.rs:132`, `contour_chain.rs:47`). I tested this with a scratch probe that I did not keep: the `contour_start_point.rs` box job, a 90-degree work offset about the origin, and a start pick at `(36, 0)`.
   - With the rule removed (main's behaviour), the cut enters at `(0, 25)`, on the wrong wall.
   - On this head, the cut enters at `(35, 0)`, at the pick.

   The change is correct, but it changes a Contour toolpath and its posted G-code. No test pins it. Also, the body says under "Not exercised" that no other kind reads a pick under a rotated work offset. That is not correct.
   - Add a Contour test under a rotated work offset to `crates/app/tests/contour_start_point.rs`, with the start and the exit pick.
   - Correct the "Not exercised" line.
   - Add the Contour fix to the `Changelog:` line.

### Optional, non-blocking

- `Raster::held` reads only the first piece of the first cut row and the last piece of the last cut row. If a keep-out takes two terminal rows, the next row runs in the same direction and is accepted. The entry stays on the picked X side, but it moves one row pitch per taken row in Y. The protected area stays clear, so this is not a safety problem. A note on the path could say where the raster starts.

### Notes

- Build host: the local sccache wrapper did not answer compile requests in this session. I built without it (`env -u RUSTC_WRAPPER`).
- Label: `needs-rework` (item 1) and `conflicts`. The PR stays a draft.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

This is a re-review of head `e7a7b3582`. It is a safety-tier review: the change moves the Face toolpath, and the Contour toolpath under a Z-rotated work offset.

### Earlier findings (review on `e07a88d09`)

1. **The merge turned the Slot picks two times** (`wcs_yaw.rs`, `rotate_params`): fixed. The merge commit `411105864` removes the pick loop of the `OpParams::Slot` arm. The one rule after the `match` turns each pick one time. `pick_kinds.rs`, `start_exit_shared.rs` and `mcp/tools.rs` keep the additions of the two sides. My mutation A (below) puts the Slot loop back, and the four Slot yaw tests fail.
2. **Pin the Contour change of the general rule**: fixed. `a_rotated_work_offset_reads_the_contour_picks_in_the_setup_frame` in `crates/app/tests/contour_start_point.rs` pins the start and the exit pick under a 90-degree work offset. My mutation B (below) removes the rule, and this test fails. The body now has the Contour entry in "What changed", the corrected "Not exercised" line, and the Contour text in the `Changelog:` line.

### Trial merge

The trial merge with `upstream/main` `267ee5096` is clean. Main added the 5-Axis Contour picks (#3330) after the last review. I read how they meet the general rule:

- `Contour5D` is not in `wcs_yaw::op_applies`, so `rotate_params` does not turn its picks. Its arm in `generate.rs` reads `params.path_picks()` in the model frame. The two changes do not interact.
- `pick_kinds.rs` merges the two arms: `Contour | Contour5D => Ring` and `Face => Raster`.

### Results (local, on the trial merge)

- `camcraft-motion --test face_start_exit`: 14 passed.
- `camcraft-app`:
  - `face_start_exit`: 10 passed.
  - `contour_start_point`: 11 passed.
  - `slot_start_exit`: 10 passed.
  - `start_exit_shared`: 15 passed (this includes the new `contour5d` module from main).
  - `example_catalog`: 43 passed, 4 ignored.
  - `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
  - `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
  - `golden_cl`: 34 passed.
  - `solid_law_goldens`: 7 passed.
  - lib, filter `boundary_turn wcs_yaw pick`: 18 passed (this includes `a_start_pick_names_the_part_corner_under_every_turn`).
- `camcraft-ui --lib start_exit` (run from `crates/ui`): 22 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: `wall 8.3 min, 6 step(s), 0 failed, 0 stalled`.
- Heavy lanes: not run. By AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" (#3556), a `P2` PR gets no heavy step. The author's four targeted heavy steps on `e7a7b3582` are green (`face_holes`, `top_z_stock_over`, `arc_turn_kinds`, `app heavy: example_catalog`).
- The author's quick gate on `e7a7b3582` (base `49bfcaea8`): `933 step(s), 0 failed, 0 stalled`.
- Build host: I built without the sccache wrapper (`env -u RUSTC_WRAPPER`).

### Extra suites run

- Golden directories: the diff adds five CL files in `crates/motion/tests/golden/` and `crates/app/tests/golden/`. I ran `golden_cl`, `solid_law_goldens`, the three `example_catalog*` suites and the two `face_start_exit` suites. All passed.
- Importers: the diff does not touch import code. No kernel suite is necessary.

### Goldens

- Against `upstream/main`, only the five new CL files differ. The body lists all five under "Goldens moved". The review on `1c8359580` checked each line of these files.
- Between `e07a88d09` and `e7a7b3582`, the only recorded file that differs is `wire_dxf_spline_die.nc`. It comes from main in the merge, and it is the same as on `upstream/main`.

### Mutations (separate runs, code restored after each)

- A: put the pick loop back into the `OpParams::Slot` arm of `rotate_params` (the result of a clean git merge). Result: red, the four `the_*_pick_holds_under_*_degree_wcs_yaw` tests of `slot_start_exit.rs`.
- B: remove the pick rule after the `match` in `rotate_params`. Result: red, `a_rotated_work_offset_reads_the_contour_picks_in_the_setup_frame`, `a_rotated_work_offset_reads_the_picks_in_the_setup_frame` and the four Slot yaw tests.

The restored tree passed `slot_start_exit`, `face_start_exit` and `contour_start_point` again.

### Optional, non-blocking

- The panic text of `every_kind_has_one_pick_capability_and_only_the_taken_ones_take_a_pick` lists the kinds that take a pick. It does not name the 5-Axis Contour, which main added. The test does not fail, because that arm is explicit.
- Overlap with #3970: `Drill`, `Bore` and `Thread` are in `wcs_yaw::op_applies`. After this PR, `rotate_params` turns their picks. If #3970 adds a pick loop in the `Drill` / `Bore` / `Thread` arm, each pick turns two times. The PR that merges second must keep the one rule only.
- From the review on `e07a88d09`: `Raster::held` reads only the first and the last cut row. This note is not changed.

### Follow-ups (file after merge)

- `P7`: the PR adds two new top-level test binaries, `crates/app/tests/face_start_exit.rs` and `crates/motion/tests/face_start_exit.rs`. The earlier reviews read these files and did not raise this, so it does not block here.

- `needs-rework` is removed: this clean review of the new head replaces the change request on `e07a88d09`.
- `conflicts` is removed: the trial merge with `267ee5096` is clean.
